entities.name: Rat
entities.description: Small omnivorous rodents found on many planes, often plague carriers and appearing in large numbers.

entities.name: Ratfolk
entities.description: A race of sentient rats on Bloomburrow, isolationist keepers of secrets and ancient relics who worship the Fell Comet.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: The plane of animalfolk where ratfolk live.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: The Bloomburrow region whose marshes hide the Knowledge Ossuaries.

entities.name: Knowledge Ossuaries
entities.description: Cavernous tunnels beneath Valley's marshes where ratfolk store relics.

entities.name: The World Whorl
entities.description: The name ratfolk give the sum of their knowledge.

entities.name: Fell Comet
entities.description: A floating comet above an underground pond beneath Valley that ratfolk worship.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Beasts that a mischievous interloper nearly unleashed on Bloomburrow.

entities.name: Oskar
entities.description: A New Capenna figure who enjoys the company of rats.

entities.name: Xarl
entities.description: A Dominarian whose sister Init was killed by wharf rats.

entities.name: Init
entities.description: Xarl's sister, killed by wharf rats.

entities.name: Lord Skitter
entities.description: A large intelligent demonic rat beneath Edgewall who ruled a horde of rats.

entities.name: Edgewall
entities.description: The Eldraine place Lord Skitter's rats failed to invade.

entities.name: Nezumi
entities.description: A race of anthropomorphic rats native to Kamigawa who live in poverty and are often ninja.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane native to the nezumi.

entities.name: Karumonix
entities.description: A Phyrexian creature formed when rats ate each other and their bones fused; it can sense and manipulate rodents.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: A Rathi figure who used the rats of Rath to scrutinize entrails.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Ruler whose dungeons were infested with Rabid Rats.

events.summary: A mischievous interloper nearly causes an apocalypse by trying to control the Calamity Beasts, after which ratfolk become secretive.
events.quote: a mischievous interloper nearly caused an apocalypse with an unsuccessful attempt to control the Calamity Beasts

events.summary: Wharf rats cause the death of Xarl's sister Init.
events.quote: Wharf Rats were found in port cities and other places in Golthonor

events.summary: After failing to invade Edgewall, Lord Skitter's rats presumably devour him and the rats return to normal.
events.quote: After failing to invade Edgewall, his rats presumably devoured him

events.summary: Phyrexian rats grow so numerous that they eat each other and their bones fuse into Karumonix.
events.quote: Eventually, rats became so numerous that some began to eat each other, and their bones began to fuse.

relations.quote: he ruled over a horde of rats
inhabiting the ancient dwarven ruins beneath Edgewall
